test_title: PYST 1 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Which of the following sentences uses the word "bank" with the **same meaning** as in the following sentence?

"The river overflowed its bank after the storm."

options.text: The teller at the bank smiled as she counted the money
He used a shovel to bank the soil around the new plant
The airplane began to bank to the left as it approached the runway.
They enjoyed a picnic on the grassy bank of the stream.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. They enjoyed a picnic on the grassy bank of the stream .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "bank" in the sentence "The river overflowed its bank after the storm" refers to the land alongside a river or stream.
 
• Option 4, "They enjoyed a picnic on the grassy bank of the stream," uses the word "bank" with the same meaning, referring to the land beside a stream.
 
• The other options use "bank" with different meanings:
 
 
• Option 1 refers to a financial institution.
 
• Option 2 refers to piling up soil (verb usage).
 
• Option 3 refers to the tilting movement of an airplane.
 
 

Correct sentence: *"They enjoyed a picnic on the grassy bank of the stream."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Different meanings of the word "bank":**
 
 
• **Land beside a river or stream:** As used in the given sentence and Option 4.
 
• **Financial institution:** As used in Option 1.
 
• **To pile up soil:** As used in Option 2.
 
• **Tilt movement:** As used in Option 3.
